rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a blastocyst and notes possible collapse/thinned zona, but it overstates confidence in identifying a compact ICM and cohesive TE from this low-detail single image; suggestion that some labs might call it 4AA is speculative.

Thoroughly integrates age-related aneuploidy risk, ovarian reserve/response, endometriosis, endometrial thickness, semen parameters, BMI/lifestyle, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and well structured, with appropriate emphasis on morphology versus ploidy and patient factors; minor issue is a somewhat imprecise discussion of implantation versus clinical pregnancy/live birth ranges.

Recommendations are broadly evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice, including caution about add-ons and individualized PGT-A discussion; minor deviations include some speculative comments and broad statements about endometriosis management.
Provides practical next steps for transfer, luteal support, lifestyle, and future evaluation/planning, though some recommendations remain general rather than protocol-specific.
